ITEM 1 | Golden-tan waffle, half-circle wedge with a deep square grid pattern and crisp-looking browned edges, slightly matte surface with light speckled crumbs, sits at upper right of plate, covers roughly 20% of plate area, about 1.5 cm thick | 90
ITEM 2 | Strawberries, bright red halved and sliced pieces with white cores visible, glossy moist surface, scattered at right edge beside waffle, about 4-5 pieces each 2-3 cm | 60
ITEM 3 | Blueberries, dark blue-purple whole berries with slight bloom, about 8-10 berries each around 1 cm diameter, clustered near strawberries at right | 25
ITEM 4 | Pale green cubed fruit, firm cubes about 1.5-2 cm with translucent pale green flesh and slightly glossy wet surface, four to five pieces stacked near center-left of plate | 55
ITEM 5 | Small brown-gold cube, about 1.5 cm, with darker caramelized exterior and matte textured surface, sitting between the green cubes and waffle | 12
ITEM 6 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green crinkled leaves with visible veins, slightly glossy, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across at lower left-center, with thin orange shredded carrot strands mixed through | 35
ITEM 7 | Cherry tomato, small glossy red whole fruit about 2 cm diameter, sitting on the spinach at left edge | 12
ITEM 8 | Shredded carrot, thin bright orange matchstick strands scattered through the spinach mound, a few tenths of a cm thick and 3-4 cm long | 5
